facts.text: Brasserie Cuvillies serves refined, seasonal Bavarian dishes crafted from local ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Brasserie Cuvilliés celebrates Bavarian heritage with refined, seasonal dishes crafted from local ingredients

facts.text: Bar Montez serves signature cocktails and snacks with live jazz and pays homage to Lola Montez, muse of King Ludwig I of Bavaria.
facts.excerpt: At Bar Montez, savor signature cocktails and snacks with live jazz, paying homage to Lola Montez, the legendary performer and muse of King Ludwig I of Bavaria.

facts.text: The light-flooded Wintergarten serves breakfasts and afternoon teas from pastry chef Shinas Shahida, with a fireplace.
facts.excerpt: Our light-flooded Wintergarten offers elegant Bavarian dining, whether through relaxed breakfasts, artful afternoon teas from pastry chef Shinas Shahida, or moments by the fireplace.

facts.text: Palaishof is an open-air dining spot set within a secluded inner courtyard.
facts.excerpt: Set within a secluded inner courtyard, Palaishof is an elegant open-air dining destination at Rosewood Munich

facts.text: Schanigarten is a Bavarian-inspired terrace for lunch, golden-hour drinks or dinners under the stars.
facts.excerpt: A Bavarian‑inspired terrace where city buzz meets laid‑back elegance, perfect for lingering over lunch, golden‑hour drinks, or starlit dinners.

facts.text: The private dining room at Brasserie Cuvillies seats up to 14 guests, directly beside the main restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Accommodates up to 14 guests, located directly beside the main restaurant.

facts.text: 100B is a hidden speakeasy behind an unmarked door.
facts.excerpt: Behind an unmarked door, 100B invites you into a world of mystery and indulgence.

facts.text: Chef Matthias Brenner offers a four-course Alpine-inspired dinner for two at Brasserie Cuvillies, with optional wine pairings.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a four-course Alpine-inspired dinner by Chef Matthias Brenner at Brasserie Cuvilliés, with optional wine pairings.

facts.text: Even the cocktails at Brasserie Cuvillies are made with locally sourced ingredients whenever possible.
facts.excerpt: where even our cocktails are crafted using locally sourced ingredients whenever possible.

facts.text: The Houses offer one to four bedroom layouts with services such as butler care, flexible arrivals and private wellness sessions.
facts.excerpt: The Houses offer one to four bedroom layouts with spacious interiors and thoughtful details, paired with tailored services such as butler care, flexible arrivals and private wellness sessions.

facts.text: Family suites combine rooms and suites so friends and family can stay together.
facts.excerpt: Designed for friends and family to come together, combination rooms and suites

facts.text: The hotel offers a private tour of the Nymphenburg Porcelain Manufactory.
facts.excerpt: Discover an exclusive private tour of the renowned Nymphenburg Porcelain Manufactory

facts.text: Bar Montez has a piano and wood-paneled walls with a cozy, library-like feel.
facts.excerpt: this elegant bar offers a piano, wood-paneled walls, and a cozy, library-like charm.

facts.text: The hotel comprises two historic buildings: the Palais Neuhaus-Preysing from 1703 and the former State Bank of Bavaria headquarters built in 1894.
facts.excerpt: The Rosewood Munich comprises two historical buildings: a former aristocratic residence called the Palais Neuhaus-Preysing, dating from 1703, and the one-time headquarters of the State Bank of Bavaria, built in 1894.

facts.text: The interiors preserve original elements such as the grand staircase and Baroque frescoes in the lobby.
facts.excerpt: preserving some of the original elements such as the grand staircase and Baroque frescoes in the lobby

facts.text: The interiors were reimagined by local architects Hilmer Sattler Architekten Ahlers Albrecht.
facts.excerpt: the inside was reimagined by local architectural firm Hilmer Sattler Architekten Ahlers Albrecht

facts.text: The guest rooms were designed by London-based Tara Bernerd and Partners.
facts.excerpt: guest rooms were designed by London-based interior design group Tara Bernerd and Partners

facts.text: Rooms feature whimsical artwork by German illustrator Olaf Hajek.
facts.excerpt: livened up with whimsical artwork from German illustrator Olaf Hajek

facts.text: The hotel is in the middle of Munich's old town, the Altstadt.
facts.excerpt: The hotel has a very convenient location in the middle of Munich’s old town (Altstadt)

facts.text: The Asaya spa has an indoor pool, two saunas and an herbal steam bath.
facts.excerpt: The Asaya spa ticks all the boxes for a relaxing break: lovely indoor pool, two saunas, and an herbal steam bath.

facts.text: Kids can join cooking and arts and crafts classes, and babysitters are available on demand.
facts.excerpt: kids are well-catered to with cooking and arts and crafts classes as well as babysitters on-demand

facts.text: Bar Montez has live jazz every night.
facts.excerpt: This moody bar has live jazz every night
